question: Which paths are assigned to those lacking the four defining characteristics?
premises: Some people lack four defining characteristics
Certain paths are assigned to them
The Kaula and others are named
inference: For those lacking the four characteristics, the paths are the Kaula and others.
uncertainties: The four characteristics are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: For those devoid of the four characteristics, the paths will be the Kaula and others.
